alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 5 at 1:50AM EDT until October 5 at 9:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: * WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 15 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and waves around 2 feet expected. * WHERE...In Massachusetts coastal waters, Boston Harbor. In Rhode Island coastal waters, Narragansett Bay. * WHEN...From 3 PM this afternoon to 9 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
